contentItem.title: 性质与证明：中项无理线段与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: The side of a rational plus a medial area is divided at one point only.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: The side of a rational plus a medial area is divided at one point only.
有理加中项无理线段区的一面只分割一个点。

Let AB be the side of a rational plus a medial area divided at C, so that AC, CB are incommensurable in square and make the sum of the squares on AC, CB medial, but twice the rectangle AC, CB rational; [[X. 40](/principles/euclid-10-40) ] I say that AB is not so divided at another point.
让AB成为有理加上中项无理线段个面积的一边,面积分为C,这样,正方形的AC,CB就达到不可公度,正方形的正方形总数是AC,CB,中项无理线段,但比矩形,AC,CB,有理的2倍。] 我说,AB不是在另一个时间点这样分裂的。 [ [X. 40](/principles/euclid-10-40)
For, if possible, let it be divided at D also, so that AD, DB are also incommensurable in square and make the sum of the squares on AD, DB medial, but twice the rectangle AD, DB rational.
如果可能的话,也将其分为D,正方形AD,DB,不可公度,正方形正方形,正方形,,DB,中项无理线段,正方形,正方形,但两倍于矩形,AD,DB,有理。

Since then that by which twice the rectangle AC, CB differs from twice the rectangle AD, DB is also that by which the squares on AD, DB differ from the squares on AC, CB, while twice the rectangle AC, CB exceeds twice the rectangle AD, DB by a rational area, therefore the squares on AD, DB also exceed the squares on AC, CB by a rational area, though they are medial: which is impossible. [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26) ]
从那时起,矩形 AC和CB的两倍与矩形 AD和DB的两倍不同,AD和AD的正方形和CB的两倍也与正方形和AC的正方形和CB的差别相同,而矩形 AC和CB的两倍比矩形和AD的2倍多,DB和AD的正方形和DB的两倍多,AC和有理面积的正方形也比正方形和中项无理线段的中项无理线段有差异,尽管它们为中项无理线段,这是不可能的 [ [X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)
Therefore the side of a rational plus a medial area is not divided at different points; therefore it is divided at one point only. Q. E. D.
因此,有理加中项无理线段区域的一侧没有在不同点上分割,因此只在一个点上分割。
